name: Defense Evasion / Lateral Movement — Service Account Interactive Logon (Type 2/10)
description: A service/privileged-named account logged on interactively (console Type 2 or RDP Type 10). Service accounts should authenticate via network (Type 3) only; interactive use indicates hands-on-keyboard misuse of a stolen service credential.
note:
### Investigation
1. Which host and source.ip? Is this account expected to be used interactively?
2. Review subsequent activity from that session.
### Tuning
If an admin legitimately uses a *.admin account interactively on a PAW, allowlist that account+host pair after validation.
author: raadabujaish
false_positives: Break-glass/admin accounts used interactively on privileged access workstations (validate + allowlist account+host).
query: event.code:"4624" and (winlog.event_data.LogonType:"2" or winlog.event_data.LogonType:"10") and winlog.event_data.TargetUserName:(*sys_user or *.servacc or *.prod or ICBS* or SIGCAP* or Forti.* or custody* or CITRIX* or Docsafe or WSS.User or SP.admin or named* or PAM or igrafxsso* or FileNet* or Office365 or Internal.services or InnScanService or TeamMatese or Solarwinds* or Veeam* or Vynamic*)
